mapper.update: update Inv_Complete_Month set actual_start_time = #{actualStartTime} WHERE P_ID = #{projectId} and icm_reporting_year = #{icmReportingYear}
update Inv_Complete_Month set actual_end_time = #{actualEndTime} WHERE P_ID = #{projectId} and icm_reporting_year = #{icmReportingYear}
update Inv_Complete_Month set cumulative_Start = #{currentMonthStart},current_month_start = null,plan_complete_result = null WHERE icm_Id = #{icmId}
update Inv_Complete_Month set cumulative_Complete =#{currentMonthComplete},current_month_complete = null,complete_result = null WHERE icm_Id = #{icmId}
mapper.select: select sd.D_Name as icmDName, pro.P_Name as pName, con.Con_Name as conName, pro.P_Name_History as pNameHistory, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.*, pro.P_Build_Model as pBuildModel, ipv.Ipv_P_Type as ipvPType, ipv.Ipv_Construction_stage as ipvConstructionStage from Inv_Complete_Month mn left join Inv_Plan_Year ipv ON mn.Ipv_Id = ipv.Ipv_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join SYS_Department sd on mn.Icm_D_Id=sd.D_ID left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Icm_Id where mn.Icm_Id=#{icmId}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY P_Id,Icm_Reporting_Month ORDER BY cast(Icm_Reporting_Month as int) DESC) AS rn FROM Inv_Complete_Month where transfer_status='06' ) t WHERE t.rn = 1
select distinct mn.${value} from Inv_Complete_Month mn where mn.${value} is not null order by mn.${value} asc

select distinct ipv.${value} from Inv_Complete_Month mn Left join Inv_Plan_Year ipv ON mn.p_id = ipv.p_id and mn.icm_reporting_year = ipv.Ipv_Declare_Year where ipv.${value} is not null order by ipv.${value} asc
select distinct pp.${value} from Inv_Complete_Month mn left join pre_project pp on mn.p_id = pp.p_id where pp.${value} is not null order by pp.${value} asc

select distinct prod.${value} from Inv_Complete_Month mn left join pre_project pp on mn.p_id = pp.p_id left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pp.P_Competent_Department where prod.${value} is not null order by prod.${value} asc
mapper.sql: left join ( select ipv2.Ipv_Id, LISTAGG(d.D_Name, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.D_Id) as dep_names from Inv_Plan_Year ipv2 join SYS_Department d on INSTR(',' || ipv2.p_competent_departments || ',', ',' || d.D_Id || ',') > 0 group by ipv2.Ipv_Id ) depAgg on depAgg.Ipv_Id = ipv.Ipv_Id

left join ( select ipv2.Ipv_Id, GROUP_CONCAT(d.D_Name ORDER BY d.D_Id SEPARATOR ',') as dep_names from Inv_Plan_Year ipv2 join SYS_Department d on FIND_IN_SET(d.D_Id, ipv2.p_competent_departments) group by ipv2.Ipv_Id ) depAgg on depAgg.Ipv_Id = ipv.Ipv_Id

left join SYS_User u on u.u_id = pro.P_Engineer left join ( select dp.p_id as p_id, LISTAGG(up.u_name, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY up.u_id) as all_names from sys_user up left join SYS_Position_User_P pup on pup.u_id = up.u_id left join SYS_Position_P pp on pp.pp_id = pup.pp_id left join SYS_Department_P dp on dp.pd_id = pp.pd_id where pp.PP_Code = #{params.jbr} group by dp.p_id ) jbrAgg on jbrAgg.p_id = mn.P_Id

left join SYS_User u on u.u_id = pro.P_Engineer left join ( select dp.p_id as p_id, GROUP_CONCAT(up.u_name ORDER BY up.u_id SEPARATOR ',') as all_names from sys_user up left join SYS_Position_User_P pup on pup.u_id = up.u_id left join SYS_Position_P pp on pp.pp_id = pup.pp_id left join SYS_Department_P dp on dp.pd_id = pp.pd_id where pp.PP_Code = #{params.jbr} group by dp.p_id ) jbrAgg on jbrAgg.p_id = mn.P_Id
mapper.select:
select mn.*, ipv.Ipv_Planned_Investment as ipvPlannedInvestment, ims.Ims_Cumulative_Inv as imsCumulativeInv from Inv_Complete_Month mn Left join Inv_Plan_Year ipv ON mn.Ipv_Id = ipv.Ipv_Id left join Inv_Monthly_Schedule ims on mn.Ipv_Id = ims.Ipv_Id and ims.Ims_Month = mn.Icm_Reporting_Month where mn.Ipv_Id in
#{item}

select mn.Con_Id, ifnull(sum(mn.Icm_Monthly_Investment), 0) as IcmMonthlyInvestment from Inv_Complete_Month mn
and mn.Con_Id in
#{conId}
group by mn.Con_Id

choose.when: and ipv.Ipv_State = 7 and ipv.Ipv_Declare_Year = to_char(now(), 'yyyy') and cast(to_char(now(), 'mm') as int) >= mn.Icm_Reporting_Month and (mn.Icm_State = 7 or cast(mn.transfer_status as int) = 7)

and ipv.Ipv_State = 7 and ipv.Ipv_Declare_Year = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y') and cast(date_format(now(), '%c') as unsigned) >= mn.Icm_Reporting_Month and (mn.Icm_State = 7 or cast(mn.transfer_status as unsigned) = 7)
